assertion_results.text: Data extraction identifies the ecosystem as RPM based on the library name (openssl-libs) and component context, not Cargo (Step 1 Ecosystem detection — read ecosystems from Ecosystem Mappings config)
assertion_results.evidence: data-extraction.md Ecosystem Detection section states: 'Vulnerable library openssl-libs is an RPM system package' and shows RPM in the Ecosystem Mappings table with rpms.lock.yaml as the lock file. Classification: 'System package (RPM)'. No mention of Cargo anywhere in any output file.

assertion_results.text: Version impact table includes ALL versions from the 2.2.x stream supportability matrix (2.2.0 through 2.2.4) and uses rpms.lock.yaml data for version extraction (Step 2.3)
assertion_results.evidence: version-impact.md table lists all five versions: 2.2.0 (v0.4.5, 3.0.7-25.el9_3), 2.2.1 (v0.4.8, 3.0.7-27.el9_4), 2.2.2 (v0.4.9, 3.0.7-27.el9_4), 2.2.3 (v0.4.11, 3.0.7-28.el9_4), 2.2.4 (v0.4.12, 3.0.7-28.el9_4). Dependency chain confirms 'rpms.lock.yaml: present -> explicit install' showing rpms.lock.yaml as the data source.

assertion_results.text: Dependency chain context identifies openssl-libs as present in rpms.lock.yaml and uses this to determine the package origin — the lock file presence is the primary classification signal (Step 2.3.5)
assertion_results.evidence: version-impact.md Dependency Chain section states: 'rpms.lock.yaml: present -> explicit install', 'Origin: explicit install (openssl-libs specified in rpms.lock.yaml)', and 'The rpms.lock.yaml classification (explicit install) is used as the sole determination of package origin.' Lock file presence is explicitly the primary (and sole) classification signal.

assertion_results.text: Remediation creates a single task for the Konflux release repo — not the two-task upstream backport + downstream propagation flow used for source dependency ecosystems (Step 8 Remediation Task Creation — system package path)
assertion_results.evidence: remediation.md states: 'Ecosystem classification: RPM (system package) -- create 1 task (Konflux release repo fix)'. Only one jira.create_issue call is present, targeting repository 'rhtpa-release.0.4.z' (Konflux release repo). No upstream backport task exists anywhere in the output.

assertion_results.text: Remediation task description follows task-description-template.md format with Repository, Target Branch, Description, Implementation Notes, and Acceptance Criteria sections — Files to Modify is intentionally omitted per remediation-templates.md (Step 8 Remediation Task Creation)
assertion_results.evidence: remediation.md task description contains all required sections: '## Repository' (rhtpa-release.0.4.z), '## Target Branch' (main), '## Description' (CVE details and affected versions), '## Implementation Notes' (package origin, update instructions), '## Acceptance Criteria' (two checkboxes). No 'Files to Modify' section is present, correctly omitted per remediation-templates.md for system package path.

assertion_results.text: The version impact output addresses SBOM verification in the dependency chain context — either noting that verification was skipped because cosign is not available or because external tools are prohibited, or presenting the SBOM classification result (Step 2.3.5 Optional SBOM verification)
assertion_results.evidence: version-impact.md dependency chain includes 'SBOM verification: skipped -- cosign not available' and elaborates: 'SBOM verification via cosign download sbom was not performed because cosign is not available in this environment. The rpms.lock.yaml classification (explicit install) is used as the sole determination of package origin.'
